description: Generate a professional git commit message from the repo's current diff. Analyzes all staged, unstaged, and untracked changes, categorizes them, and creates the commit directly once the user approves it, then asks before pushing it (paste-safe commands are a fallback). Trigger on: "commit", "write a commit", "commit message", "what changed", "summarize changes", "draft commit", "changelog", or any request to commit, stage, or describe the current diff.
